text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of Agnes Tachyon's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I was lamenting over the fact that I ran out of black tea in the lab. How unbecoming of me to forget to restock, no?
choice_data_list: (That's got nothing to do with today's race!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know. You can go out to purchase some for me while I race. Ceylon or Keemun is my preference.
choice_data_list: There's no way I'm missing your race.
There's no way I'm missing your race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh my, would you look at the time. It appears I must get going.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If you can't find either of the two I mentioned, Assam tea will also do. Would you be so kind as to deliver it to my lab?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon saunters out of the waiting room.
